newsitem.title: JAPAN: Namco, Sony Computer, Poligon to form CG venture.
newsitem.headline: Namco, Sony Computer, Poligon to form CG venture.

text.p: Namco Ltd, Sony Computer Entertainment Inc, a unit of Sony Corp, and Poligon Pictures Inc said on Wednesday that they would set up a computer graphics joint venture in Japan on March 12.
The venture, to be called Dream Pictures Studio (DPS), will be capitalised at 200 million yen, the three companies said in a joint statement.
Namco, a computer game software company, and Sony Computer Entertainment will each hold 45 percent in the firm, while Poligon, a computer graphics firm, will own 10 percent, the statement said.
The new company will produce motion pictures using computer graphics and other entertainment software, the statement said.

"DPS will recruit human resources from around the world and function as a development and educational institution. We will aim to provide the world's best artists and products in the field of digital content," they said.
